questions.q: What does the label 'from code' promise?
options: It was read in the source, and a script found the file and line
questions.answer: It was read in the source, and a script found the file and line
questions.why: It proves the code is there. It does not prove the method works well.

questions.q: A render says 'measured here', one seed. What can you conclude?
options: It happened, and it shows a difference on that seed
This method is better in general
It will look the same on your seed
questions.answer: It happened, and it shows a difference on that seed
questions.why: One seed and one prompt show a difference. They do not rank.

questions.q: On the bench, a slope of −2 means:
options: Doubling the calls cuts the error to about a quarter
Doubling the calls halves the error
It uses two calls per step
The picture is twice as sharp
questions.answer: Doubling the calls cuts the error to about a quarter
questions.why: 2 to the power of −2 is 0.25. The lab shows 0.21 for heun's −2.24.
